prompt:
Flat vector illustration, a background scene for a minimalist mobile adventure game of the 2010s. Technique: clean vector shapes with crisp edges, built from simple geometric forms with gently rounded corners and smooth curves; flat colour fills, some large shapes with one soft linear gradient; no outlines, no strokes, no texture, no grain, no noise, no brush marks, no fine detail. Depth only through overlapping silhouette layers with aerial perspective: every layer farther away is lighter, less saturated and closer to the sky colour. Palette: about twelve harmonious colours - deep indigo and violet, dusty pink, warm orange and amber light, cream white, one red accent; the dusk sky is a smooth gradient from deep indigo at the top through violet and pink to a warm orange band at the horizon. Light: soft and even, no cast shadows except simple flat shadow shapes. Composition: wide side view at eye level, the quay as a horizontal band along the bottom, open calm water in the middle, generous empty space, few large shapes. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not painterly, not a detailed postcard, no realistic textures.

Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.

Draw the lighthouse lamp only as a small glowing spot without any beam, the lantern as a small lit shape without any halo, and no smoke from the chimney (they are animated separately in the game). Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: landscape 3:2.

Flat vector game character for a minimalist mobile adventure game of the 2010s. Technique: the figure is strongly simplified and built from a few clean geometric vector shapes - a rounded pear-shaped body, a round head with a pointed snout, short capsule-shaped legs and arms - flat colour fills, at most one soft gradient on the body, no outlines, no strokes, no fur texture, no shading detail, no fine lines, crisp edges, a small dot eye. Palette: charcoal grey fur, cream face stripe and belly, dark green cap and vest, cream shirt, red scarf, brown satchel, light brown parcel. Pose: full body in clean side view facing right, standing upright and relaxed, both feet flat on the ground. The reference image shows only the costume and the proportions of the character; drawing style, simplification and palette follow this description, not the reference. Not a 3D render, not painterly, no texture.

The badger courier: an original mascot character, a stout, short-legged badger with a broad black-and-white striped face, wearing a dark green peaked cap with a brass button, a dark green vest with pockets over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long red knitted scarf, a brown leather satchel on a shoulder strap, and a brown paper parcel tied with string under one arm.

A single character, isolated on a fully transparent background, no ground, no shadow.

No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.

Image format: square 1:1.
